title: 〜を踏まえて / 〜を踏まえ
simpleExplanation: 〜を踏まえて means "standing on X as a basis": 前回の反省を踏まえて (taking last time's lessons into account), 調査結果を踏まえ (based on the survey results). 踏まえる = to stand firmly on. It implies that facts, results or experience were properly considered before a judgement or plan.
whenUsed: Business, academic and official writing and formal speech: reports, proposals, policy statements. Typical nouns: 結果・反省・現状・経験・意見・議論・事実. In casual speech, 〜をもとに or 〜を考えて are used.
formation: N + を踏まえた上で、V (after taking into account)

examples.ja: 前回の反省を踏まえて、今回は計画を練り直した。
examples.reading: ぜんかいのはんせいをふまえて、こんかいはけいかくをねりなおした。
examples.en: Taking the lessons of last time into account, we reworked the plan this time.
examples.note: Lessons from last time as the basis for reworking the plan.

examples.ja: アンケートの結果を踏まえ、サービスを改善します。
examples.reading: アンケートのけっかをふまえ、サービスをかいぜんします。
examples.en: Based on the survey results, we will improve our service.
examples.note: Formal continuative を踏まえ: survey results as the basis.

examples.ja: 現状を踏まえた上で、今後の方針を決めたい。
examples.reading: げんじょうをふまえたうえで、こんごのほうしんをきめたい。
examples.en: I would like to decide future policy after taking the current situation into account.
examples.note: を踏まえた上で: after taking the situation into account.

examples.ja: 専門家の意見を踏まえて、新しい安全基準が作られた。
examples.reading: せんもんかのいけんをふまえて、あたらしいあんぜんきじゅんがつくられた。
examples.en: New safety standards were drawn up taking experts' opinions into account.

examples.ja: 過去の失敗を踏まえた対策が求められている。
examples.reading: かこのしっぱいをふまえたたいさくがもとめられている。
examples.en: Measures that take past failures into account are called for.

similarGrammar.difference: "Based on" data or rules as a foundation; を踏まえて stresses consideration before judging.
"In line with" reality or rules; the result matches X closely.
"Using X as material" (a story based on a true event); more about source material than judgement.

commonMistakes.wrong: 結果を踏まえて、何も変えなかった。
commonMistakes.right: 結果を踏まえて、計画を見直した。
commonMistakes.why: The main clause should be a judgement or action that reflects X.

commonMistakes.right: 彼の意見を踏まえて決めた。
commonMistakes.why: The noun must be facts, results or opinions, not a person.
The set phrase is 踏まえた上で.

usageNotes: を踏まえた上で is very common in formal proposals.
It signals due diligence: the speaker did their homework before deciding.
jlptTips: Facts / results + blank + a decision or plan → を踏まえて.
Distractors: に基づいて, に即して, をもとに. Choose を踏まえて for "taking into consideration before judging".
Before a noun use を踏まえた; before 上で use 踏まえた上で.
